scope: bounded deterministic action deliberation with capability, budget, risk, approval, kill-switch and memory; no LLM/tool I/O or external effects claim; native execution in fresh local handlers, SQLite SQL-function transactions and a bounded worker-thread dataflow pipeline; no cloud FaaS, arbitrary SQL, external stream or OS sandbox claim

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

runtimeControls: SQLite reopen recovery and rejected-result rollback
authorityProfile: local source/binary-bound job execution, frozen cases and unchanged fresh independent proposals; no new hosted CI

trials.intent: Reject an action whose required capability does not equal the granted capability; all other eligibility checks still apply.
Reject actions whose cost exceeds the available budget; equal cost is permitted if all other checks pass.
An action requiring human approval must be rejected while approval is absent and may be considered when approval is present.
